messages:
Elaine: uploaded the updated price sheet (v4) and initial cohort mapping. planning a staged A/B roll next Tue 09:00 PT. please review grandfather exceptions and opt-out flow: https://g.co/redwood/pricing-v4.
Sam: quick Q — what's our primary guardrail? revenue delta or invoice format stability?
Elaine: primary = no invoice line changes for committed deals; secondary = <3% net revenue delta vs control week 1.
Raj: billing needs cohort mapped to billing_account_id and a reconciliation key by EOD Fri. also need a metering compare job to prevent double-billing.
Marco: ops will run a 120-account canary (30 L / 40 M / 50 H). i'll tag canary accounts with `cutover_canary=true`. need the CSV by Fri 5pm.
Olivia: Legal: auto-grandfather customers with signed addenda before 2025-08-01 until 2027-08-01. must include explicit notice line.
Alex: support will implement an admin flag `pricing_transition_exempt` for opt-outs. support-only for first 48h, then consider self-serve.
Raj: sample reconciliation fragment i'll run after cutover:
SELECT billing_account_id, period, old_tokens, new_tokens, new_amount - old_amount AS amount_delta
FROM billing_delta
WHERE period = '2026-11';
Marco: ops checklist: cohort CSV, canary tagging, reconciliation job, staged banner, rollback toggle. I'll post a short runbook in #release-war-room.
billing-bot: File uploaded: pricing-v4-cohort.csv (uploaded by Elaine) :file_folder:
Elaine: decision log: grandfather cutoff = signed addenda before 2025-08-01 until 2027-08-01; A/B split = 30% control / 70% variant; canary = 120 accounts. freeze cohort Fri 17:00 PT.
Sam: noted. i'll monitor revenue dashboards day-of.
Raj: blocker: two consolidated-billing parents need full parent->sub mapping to avoid partial cutovers; i'll DM details.
Elaine: please drop final exceptions into the sheet. locking cohort Fri 5pm. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
